races.name: Powell & Construction Poultry Buildings Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Un Sens A La Vie
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with highest class but 74 days off and trainer struggling with 0/20 strike rate recently
runners_data.comment: Dual hurdle winner and he sets a clear standard back in much calmer waters; strong claims
runners_data.spotlight: Record of 2-5 over hurdles and he was runner-up behind subsequent Supreme winner Old Park Star at Kempton (2m, good)  in November; finished a well-held fourth of 15 at Newbury in February but that was a major handicap and not many got involved in the testing conditions; sets a clear standard back in much calmer waters and his last win was over C&D; strong contender.

runners_data.name: Not For Passin
runners_data.note: Fellow leader who fell on hurdling debut but won well in bumpers and represents an in-form stable connection
runners_data.comment: Still early days over hurdles but he needs major improvement after a break; equipment on
runners_data.spotlight: Easy winner of a five-runner Perth bumper (good ground) last spring and later recruited for 60,000euros; fell when prominent in the market on hurdle/stable debut at Huntingdon in November and was well held in second when odds-on at Catterick last time; still early days in this sphere but he needs major improvement with equipment added after a break.

runners_data.name: Snatch A Glance
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with excellent Ludlow record but female amateur jockey takes over after recent fall here
runners_data.comment: Dual course winner who was prominent when he fell three out over C&D latest; respected
runners_data.spotlight: The last four of his six runs have been at Ludlow and he won a bumper in October and a maiden hurdle (2m, good) the following month; fell three out on his return from a break three weeks ago but he was travelling well enough in a prominent position at the time; this looks a tougher assignment but he still has potential and is respected for in-form yard.

runners_data.name: Latin
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making rare hurdles appearance but has been active on flat and represents consistent trainer
runners_data.comment: Six-time Flat winner who is unexposed over hurdles but this looks a tough assignment
runners_data.spotlight: Six-time Flat winner including five on AW (1m-1m2f) since December; unexposed over hurdles and was fair fourth of 13 back in this sphere at Hereford (2m, good; 12-1) last week; should have more to offer as a jumper but this looks a tough task against Un Sens A La Vie.

runners_data.name: Sonic Pioneer
runners_data.note: Another hold-up type with juvenile hurdle class but 88 days absent and has pulled up twice in Grade 2s
runners_data.comment: Drops back in class but he's been pulled up in his last two starts and has a bit to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Dual Flat winner whose form in juvenile hurdles includes an emphatic success at Kempton (2m, good) and two non-completions (pulled up both times) in Grade 2 races; drops back in class after a break but he has a bit to prove and probably needs to kick on again to make a major impact.

runners_data.name: Winston's Oath
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who showed some ability last time but generally outclassed in this company
runners_data.comment: Showed ability at Fakenham but he has a lot to find here and is best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who showed ability in a Fakenham maiden (2m, good) two weeks ago but he has plenty to find here and is best watched.

races.paceDynamic: Un Sens A La Vie and Not For Passin will contest the early lead in this small field, with Un Sens A La Vie's superior class likely seeing him dictate terms. The honest gallop they set will string out the field early, putting pressure on the hold-up horses Latin and Sonic Pioneer to get competitive positions. Prominent runners Snatch A Glance and Winston's Oath will track the leaders but face the challenge of when to make their moves. This race shape strongly favours the front runners and prominent racers who can sit close to the pace, as the small field and likely honest tempo will make it difficult for hold-up horses to make up significant ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Un Sens A La Vie or Not For Passin maintain their early advantage without being overpressured
scenarios.body: The class leader controls the tempo and kicks clear, or the improving Not For Passin capitalises on his recent stable switch. Small fields often reward those who can dictate terms from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Snatch A Glance uses his course form to perfection or Winston's Oath finds improvement
scenarios.body: The course specialist or improving 4yo sits in the perfect stalking position behind the two leaders before striking late. Their prominent style allows them to respond when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly strong between the two front runners
scenarios.body: Latin's flat speed or Sonic Pioneer's juvenile hurdle class comes to the fore as they pick up the pieces. The hold-up pair benefit from a collapse up front after unsustainable early fractions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners weaken significantly and no clear successor emerges
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair where any of the four with reasonable form could capitalise. Course form and recent runs become crucial in a slowly-run finish.

watchPoints.text: Un Sens A La Vie needs watching for market confidence given his long absence and stable's poor recent form
Snatch A Glance carries amateur rider Fern O'Brien after his recent fall at this track
Not For Passin fell on hurdles debut so jumping under pressure will be crucial if in front late
Sonic Pioneer has pulled up twice when stepped up in class so watch for early signs of struggling
Latin rarely runs over hurdles so market support would indicate stable confidence in the switch

races.name: Templar Medical Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Maximum Offers
runners_data.note: Prominent racer coming off an easy handicap chase win just 6 days ago, quick turnaround could be telling
runners_data.comment: Easy win over fences (3m1f) last week; major player again off 5lb higher back over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: 2m hurdle winner who landed the odds with an easy win in a handicap chase at Hereford (3m1f, good) last Thursday; that was a three-runner race but he won by a long way and is still unexposed at staying trips; major player again off 5lb higher back over hurdles.

runners_data.name: Springs A Girl
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer having first run for 38 days, needs to overcome ring-rustiness from the back
runners_data.comment: On workable mark but she's been up and down in handicaps and others are more persuasive
runners_data.spotlight: Won a novice here (2m5f, good to soft) in December 2024 but she's been up and down in handicaps since; finished second of five at Newbury (3m, soft) in February but she didn't fire at Chepstow (2m3f) last time; now goes back up in trip and down in grade but this is competitive and others are more persuasive.

runners_data.name: Noonetellsmenothin
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning from layoff after being pulled up lame, fitness and soundness questions remain
runners_data.comment: Unexposed 5yo and he could go well back up in trip; first-time blinkers
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo who won a novice at Catterick (2m3f, good to soft) in December; finished lame when pulled up on handicap debut at Kelso (2m7f, heavy) in February and he bounced back with a fair fourth at Market Rasen (2m4f; cheekpieces added) last month; looks worth another try at this sort of trip and he's not ruled out in first-time blinkers.

runners_data.name: The Egyptian Ginge
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent form, amateur jockey may struggle with tactical positioning in small field
runners_data.comment: Runner-up in his only handicap and he's in the mix at this new trip
runners_data.spotlight: 0-9 but was runner-up on handicap debut at Haydock (2m3f, good to soft) last month and he filled the same position behind an odds-on rival in a maiden at Ascot (2m3f, good) last time; needs to find more at this new trip but he still has potential and is a half-brother to a 2m7f chase winner.

runners_data.name: Catwalk Girl
runners_data.note: Only confirmed leader with 5lb claimer, point-to-point background suggests staying stamina but lacks hurdles experience
runners_data.comment: Handicap newcomer and she needs watching in market at this new trip
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner who has shown some promise in three hurdle runs this year, including when third of five at Wincanton (2m5f, good) three weeks ago; should have more to offer now switched to a handicap and her dam was a 3m winner over fences; one to keep an eye on.

runners_data.name: Tzarmix
runners_data.note: Strong stayer returning from 64-day break with excellent course form, needs to overcome extended absence
runners_data.comment: C&D win in December and he had a near-miss at Market Rasen last time; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Back from a break with a clearcut win over C&D (good to soft) in December and he's finished runner-up in three subsequent starts; up another 2lb but he had a near-miss at Market Rasen (2m7f) last time and this return to quicker ground is no problem (won a point on good to firm); respected.

runners_data.name: Windsor Blue
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who won here last time but disappointed subsequently, inconsistent profile makes her hard to trust
runners_data.comment: Won here (2m5f) in February but she failed to back that up on her return visit last month
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark with 20-1 win in a handicap here (2m5f, soft) in February but she failed to back that up on her return visit last month; still has low mileage but she needs to resume her progress at this new trip.

races.paceDynamic: Catwalk Girl is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting a manageable tempo over this 3m trip without early pressure. Maximum Offers and Noonetellsmenothin should sit prominent behind the leader, while The Egyptian Ginge, Springs A Girl and Tzarmix will need to be produced from further back. The lack of pace pressure should create a tactical affair where positioning and timing become crucial. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as the modest early gallop will compress the field and reward those with finishing speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Travellers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Catwalk Girl sets a steady pace allowing the field to stay compact
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the final hurdle where class and finishing speed decide. Hold-up horses with proven acceleration benefit most from the compressed field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If Catwalk Girl gets an uncontested lead and maintains her gallop
scenarios.body: She builds an unassailable advantage while the hold-up horses leave their runs too late. The lack of early pace pressure allows her to dictate on her own terms.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pressure Applied
scenarios.trigger: If Maximum Offers or Noonetellsmenothin challenge Catwalk Girl before the home turn
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and exposes the stamina limitations of some runners. Prominent racers with proven staying power benefit from the honest gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If nobody challenges Catwalk Girl until very late creating a crawling pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test over the final 2-3 furlongs favouring those with natural gate speed. Front runners and prominent racers gain a decisive advantage.

watchPoints.text: Catwalk Girl if she gets an easy lead - amateur riders can dictate races when uncontested
Tzarmix for market confidence given his long layoff and previous course success
Maximum Offers for signs of fatigue given his quick 6-day turnaround from Hereford
The Egyptian Ginge's amateur jockey for tactical positioning in the straight
Springs A Girl for fitness signs after 38-day absence, especially early in the race

races.name: Hr Smith Handicap Chase (For The Boyne Cup) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Almazhar Garde
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose last two DNFs are concerning, but the grade drop and his Catterick second suggest retained ability over this trip
runners_data.comment: Failed to complete last two starts but on a dangerous mark and he won this race last year
runners_data.spotlight: Not the force of old and has failed to complete in his last two starts but this is a drop back in grade and he went close at Catterick (3m1f, good) in November; looks interesting on that form and he made all when winning this race last year.

runners_data.name: Petty Cash
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who won at Chepstow over similar distance but 33 days off and wind surgery history requires monitoring
runners_data.comment: Has not seen much action in recent years and was pulled at Newbury (2m6f) last month
runners_data.spotlight: Won over fences at Chepstow (2m7f, good to soft) in November 2024 but he's not seen much action since; ran well after wind surgery when third over C&D in February but he was pulled up at Newbury (2m6f) last month; tongue-tie is now added and he needs to bounce back again after that last run.

runners_data.name: Tax For Max
runners_data.note: Patient hold-up horse with 0-8 record for current yard but showed rally when third over shorter at Haydock
runners_data.comment: Creditable third over 2m here last month; this is a different test but he's not ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Three wins at around 2m in Ireland and latest was over fences for Willie Mullins in June 2023; record of 0-8 for current yard but he rallied well when a creditable third here (2m, good) last month; this is a different test at this new trip but he's well treated on his old form and needs watching in the market; tongue-tie back on.

runners_data.name: Annie Express
runners_data.note: Prominent runner moving up 6lb after course victory but that represented a personal best effort
runners_data.comment: C&D winner who scored in good style over 2m4f here last time; big player again up 6lb
runners_data.spotlight: Has a patchy profile but she made it 2-6 over fences when justifying favouritism here (2m4f, good) last month; up 6lb but that was a personal best last time and her other chase win came over this C&D; key player.

runners_data.name: Gris Majeur
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who broke his fencing duck here in October and has been consistently placed since
runners_data.comment: In-form 9yo who was runner-up off this mark at Chepstow (2m7f) 11 days ago; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Triple hurdle winner who made the breakthrough over fences in a Ludlow handicap (2m4f, good to firm) in October; that was a four-runner race but he's been placed in four runs since including when runner-up at Chepstow (2m7f) 11 days ago; should go well again and all of his wins have been on good/good to firm.

runners_data.name: Epic West
runners_data.note: Prominent tracker returning after 69-day break but has shown his best form on softer ground conditions
runners_data.comment: 2-3 over hurdles but he's been tailed off in two of his three chase runs; risks attached
runners_data.spotlight: Irish point winner who was 2-3 as a novice hurdler last season (wins gained on soft/good to soft); his three runs over fences since December include a close second at Warwick (2m, good to soft) but he was tailed off in both runs either side of that; still lightly raced but he has something to prove on this big step back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Zacony Rebel
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran carrying bottom weight but five poor runs since his Huntingdon win raise serious doubts
runners_data.comment: Won in December but he's struggled since and is a long way out of the weights here
runners_data.spotlight: Won a five-runner handicap at Huntingdon (2m7f, soft) in December but this veteran has struggled in five subsequent runs; has lots to prove and he's a long way out of the weights.

runners_data.name: Arrycan
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 193 days off with more bad runs than good ones during his Irish campaign
runners_data.comment: On workable mark in suitable conditions but he needs to bounce back on return for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: 12yo who has won four times over fences but there were more bad runs than good ones in Ireland last year; on workable mark in suitable conditions but he was tailed off when last seen in October and needs a major revival for new yard.

races.paceDynamic: Almazhar Garde and Annie Express will likely contest the early lead, with Epic West and Arrycan sitting prominent. The pace should be honest but not breakneck over this 3m trip, as Almazhar Garde can dictate without serious pressure from fellow front-runners. The extended distance and good ground will allow the race to develop into a proper staying test. This setup favors hold-up horses who can finish strongly, as the prominent runners may soften each other up over the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves honest and the prominent runners compromise each other
scenarios.body: The race will become a war of attrition in the final half-mile, perfectly suiting horses that can produce late kicks. Patient tactics will be rewarded as the pace-setters weaken approaching the final fence.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Almazhar Garde gets an uncontested lead and finds renewed vigor
scenarios.body: The 11-year-old can use his experience to dictate terms and kick clear when others expect him to weaken. His Catterick second over a similar trip suggests he retains enough ability when conditions suit.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Epic West can position perfectly behind the leaders without getting involved early
scenarios.body: The Jamie Snowden-trained gelding can use his 7-year-old legs to outstay older rivals who have done more work. His close second over fences shows he has the class for this grade.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race will become a dash from the last fence, completely changing the complexion. This would suit horses with natural speed rather than pure stamina.

watchPoints.text: Almazhar Garde's jumping - his last two DNFs suggest confidence issues that could resurface under pressure
Tax For Max early in race - if connections abandon hold-up tactics it suggests they lack confidence in his finishing kick
Epic West's position turning in - needs to be close enough to strike but not so close he gets embroiled in pace battles
Petty Cash for signs of respiratory distress - his wind surgery history makes any hard breathing a significant concern
Annie Express jumping under pressure - her patchy profile suggests she may not handle sustained pressure as well as last time

races.name: Powell & Company Construction Stables & Buildings Mares' Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Kottayam
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with wind surgery since October but needs to prove effectiveness with new trainer after two pulled-up efforts.
runners_data.comment: 0-7 and pulled up in both handicaps; had wind op and returns for another new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who was pulled up in two handicaps (2m3f/3m1f) for Dylan Cunha in October; had wind surgery since but she's with another new yard now and needs a major revival after six months off.

runners_data.name: Imperial Pride
runners_data.note: Veteran prominent runner showing renewed form over fences but returning to hurdles after 37 days off.
runners_data.comment: Win and second over fences on last two starts and she's respected back over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran who has turned things around over fences recently, with a win at Huntingdon (2m7f, good to soft) followed by a second on similar ground at Plumpton (3m1f); now returns to hurdling but she's lightly raced in this sphere and looks interesting off the same mark as last time.

runners_data.name: Lady Dapple Rose
runners_data.note: Likely leader but hasn't progressed since promising debut second and was disappointing at Chepstow last time.
runners_data.comment: Unexposed 5yo but he needs improvement upped in trip on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Second of four on hurdling debut at Leicester (1m7f, soft) in November but she's not gone on from that and was a remote third in a Chepstow maiden last month; now switches to a handicap needing improvement on this step up in trip.

runners_data.name: After Many Days
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner with three recent seconds in handicaps, up 2lb but still looks well handicapped.
runners_data.comment: 0-18 but she's finished runner-up at around 2m4f in her last three handicaps; respected
runners_data.spotlight: 0-18 but she's finished runner-up in her last three handicaps and latest was at Hereford (2m4f, good; 15-8 favourite) last month; up another 2lb but she still looks feasibly treated and should be in the thick of things again.

runners_data.name: Jlow
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who was fourth at Ludlow just 10 days ago and suits this longer trip with strong recent form.

runners_data.name: La Cantate
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 276 days off with limited hurdles progression for current connections.
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced 5yo but she hasn't progressed over hurdles so far; opposable on her return
runners_data.spotlight: Unexposed 5yo but she hasn't progressed over hurdles so far and has been well held in two handicaps (2m4f/2m2f) for her current yard; returns after 276 days off and she needs improvement back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Klervia
runners_data.note: Prominent runner continuing to drop in weights with respectable fourth at Exeter in cheekpieces two weeks ago.
runners_data.comment: Overall record of 0-10 but was fair fourth of 13 at Exeter (2m5f, good) latest; in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: Overall record of 0-10 but she was a respectable fourth of 13 in Exeter handicap (2m5f, good; cheekpieces added) two weeks ago; continues to drop down the weights and has each-way claims if she can build on that last run.

runners_data.name: Shes All Pride
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who improved markedly when stepped up to 2m6f last time and is 3lb out of weights again.
runners_data.comment: Improved form when third at Stratford; 3lb out of the weights again but she's in this mix
runners_data.spotlight: Improved form upped to 2m6f on handicap debut when third from off the pace at Stratford (good; lost shoe) last month; 3lb out of the weights again but she was only beaten around 2l last time and that was behind a progressive rival; dangerous.

runners_data.name: Wishful Wings
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse but has fading tendencies in finishes and hasn't been closer than 12 lengths to any winner.
runners_data.comment: Still unexposed in handicaps but cheekpieces need to make a difference back over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo who hasn't finished closer than 12l to a winner and didn't get very far over fences here (unseated at third) last month; still unexposed in handicaps but cheekpieces need to make a difference back over hurdles.

runners_data.name: Jessie's Giant
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has been tailed off in all three hurdles starts and is out of the weights here.
runners_data.comment: Handicap debutante but she's out of the weights and needs major improvement upped in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Down the field in two bumpers and she's finished tailed off at big prices in three hurdle runs (2m); now goes handicapping but she's out of the weights and needs major improvement on this big step up in trip.

runners_data.name: Slack Alice
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with visor fitted but has never won and tends to find little when asked for effort.

races.paceDynamic: Lady Dapple Rose will dictate terms from the front with no obvious rival for the lead, likely accompanied by the prominent runners Kottayam, Imperial Pride, and After Many Days tracking close behind. The lack of confirmed pace pressure means Lady Dapple Rose can set sustainable fractions without being harassed early. This should create an even gallop that builds gradually, with the race developing into a proper staying test over the final 3 furlongs. This pace scenario strongly favours the hold-up horses like Jlow, Shes All Pride, and Slack Alice who can finish from off the pace when the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Dapple Rose sets uncontested fractions and the prominent runners track patiently
scenarios.body: The pace will be even throughout allowing the stamina to emerge late, with hold-up horses having plenty left for their finishing kicks. Jlow and Shes All Pride can time their challenges perfectly when the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If After Many Days and Kottayam apply early pressure to Lady Dapple Rose creating a stronger gallop
scenarios.body: The increased pace will suit those positioned prominently who can maintain their position without overexerting, with the hold-up horses left with too much to do. After Many Days' consistency at this level gives her the edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Wires The Field
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Dapple Rose gets completely uncontested fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: Her lack of recent progress becomes irrelevant as she gets ideal conditions to dictate throughout and prove too strong late. The closers will struggle to make up ground against a horse who has controlled every yard.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is extremely sedate with all runners bunched turning in
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle where tactical positioning matters more than stamina, favouring those closest to the pace. Klervia's recent Exeter fourth suggests she can handle a tactical finish.

watchPoints.text: Lady Dapple Rose could get easy fractions if no one challenges her early, making the closers' task much harder.
After Many Days has been runner-up in her last three handicaps and another place finish would be disappointing given her consistency.
Jlow's quick return after just 10 days suggests connections are confident but watch for any signs of that effort taking its toll.
Kottayam's wind surgery and new trainer combination creates uncertainty about her current wellbeing and ability.
Imperial Pride's switch back to hurdles after recent chase form needs monitoring for signs of adaptation issues.

races.name: Powell & Company Construction Agricultural Buildings Mares' Open Maiden NH Flat Race (C3 Elim) (GBB)

runners_data.name: Arm's Of An Angel
runners_data.comment: Failed to complete in three Irish points and can only be watched on her hurdling debut
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up in her first two Irish points before being carried out by a loose horse in her final run in November; can only be watched now switched to rules for new yard.

runners_data.name: Mrs Cravatte
runners_data.comment: Didn't show much in three British points and she's best watched on rules debut
runners_data.spotlight: Struggled in her first two points in May 2024 and she fell on her comeback at Siddington (3m, good) last month; opposable on rules debut.

runners_data.name: Thatsnotmyname
runners_data.comment: Yard has had a debut bumper winner this year and she needs watching in market
runners_data.spotlight: £4,000 yearling, £2,000 3yo; tenth foal; half-sister to winners San Rumoldo (bumper/2m4f hurdle), En Joule (bumper) and Perculator (bumper and 2m5f/3m hurdle); dam unraced sister to high-class bumper and 2m1f-3m chase winner The Tother One; yard has had a debut bumper winner this year and she needs watching in the market.

runners_data.name: Whiting Ash
runners_data.comment: Not an obvious type on pedigree and she could be a longer-term prospect
runners_data.spotlight: Dam triple point winner, from family of smart staying chasers Over The Deel and Smarty; not an obvious type on pedigree and she could be a longer-term prospect.

runners_data.name: Lightning Luna
runners_data.comment: Well-held fourth of six in a British point last month; best watched on her rules debut
runners_data.spotlight: Well-held fourth of six in a British point last month and is probably best watched on her rules debut.

runners_data.name: Meliden Mountain
runners_data.comment: Out of unraced sister to a useful hurdler; interesting newcomer who needs a close look
runners_data.spotlight: Second foal; dam unraced sister to useful 2m/2m1f hurdle winner Hearts Are Trumps, out of unraced sister to Cheltenham Gold Cup winner Denman; yard 15% in bumpers this season and she's an interesting newcomer.

runners_data.name: Oakstead Park
runners_data.comment: 35,000euros 3yo; one of two for the yard and interesting to see how she figures in market
runners_data.spotlight: 35,000euros 3yo; twelfth foal; sister to bumper/2m5f hurdle winner Lime Avenue, half-sister to three winners including Rogue Angel (smart 2m-3m5f hurdle/chase including Irish Grand National) and Fire In His Eyes (useful bumper/2m4f hurdle); dam unraced; one of two runners for the yard and interesting to see how she figures in the market.

runners_data.name: Mysti Meadow
runners_data.comment: Well-related 5yo who made an encouraging start over C&D last month; in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: 14-1 and raced alone on the inner in the home straight when fifth of 14 on last month's debut over C&D (good to soft); that was an encouraging start from this well-related 5yo and she should benefit from that experience; in the mix.

runners_data.name: Rose Of Knocknamoe
runners_data.comment: Well-held second in sole Irish point and was down the field on rules debut at Stratford
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in an Irish point in December but she was beaten 13l and only three completed; stumbled after getting hampered on recent rules debut at Stratford (2m, good; 9-1), finishing a well-held sixth, and needs major improvement here; stablemate of Milly Ocean.

runners_data.name: Milly Ocean
runners_data.comment: Promising fourth at Huntingdon and just about sets the standard on that form; key player
runners_data.spotlight: Attracted support into 14-1 and she showed clear promise when fourth of 14 on Huntingdon debut (2m, good) last month; just about sets the standard on that form and she should be more streetwise this time; key player for yard with record of 2-3 in bumpers here this season.

runners_data.name: Donwell Abbey
runners_data.comment: Made a low-key start at Huntingdon and she needs to leave that form well behind
runners_data.spotlight: Has a striking pedigree but she made a low-key start when 12th of 14 at Huntingdon (good; 18-1) last month, running green; needs to leave that form a long way behind.

runners_data.name: Chocolate Cosmos
runners_data.comment: Showed ability on C&D debut but she failed to build on that at Huntingdon last month
runners_data.spotlight: Well-related filly; ran well for a long way when fifth over C&D (33-1) in January but she failed to build on that when ninth of 14 at Huntingdon last month; enters the reckoning on her initial form but has something to prove after that last run.

runners_data.name: Britway Belle
runners_data.comment: Irish point winner who was a promising third in a Hereford bumper last month; in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: Bought for £120,000 after winning an Irish mares' maiden point (3m, yielding) on debut in October; tailed off on bumper debut at Hereford in January but she showed promise with her third at that track (2m, good) last month; has possibilities if she can build on that and she's a half-sister to a bumper winner.

races.name: Eddie Mapp Memorial Open Hunters' Chase

runners_data.name: Mr Glass
runners_data.note: Proven hunter chase winner with strong form for Paul Nicholls, suits the likely staying test and has winning form on similar going
runners_data.comment: Fair third on stable debut at Exeter and has possibilities if he can build on that
runners_data.spotlight: Won races for Paul Nicholls and Will Biddick and his last success was in a hunter chase at Wincanton (3m1f, heavy) last January; that form puts him in the picture and he made a respectable stable debut when third at Exeter (3m, good to soft) last month; possibilities.

runners_data.name: Fix At All
runners_data.note: Back to form this spring with solid efforts, the uncontested pace should suit his prominent racing style perfectly
runners_data.comment: Record of 0-8 for current yard and he looks vulnerable again back up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Back to form with some respectable efforts this spring but his second at Kempton (2m4f, good) was in a match and he was well held when third here last time; record for current yard is now 0-7 and he looks vulnerable again back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Potters Party
runners_data.note: High-rated with useful chase form but unseated on hunter debut, needs to prove he can handle this sphere
runners_data.comment: Fairly useful chaser in Ireland and he should have a future in hunter chases; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Fairly useful chase form for Henry de Bromhead as recently as winter 2024-25; unseated on hunter chase debut at Hexham last Monday but that was after two solid efforts in points and he should have a future in this sphere; respected.

runners_data.name: The Paddy Pie
runners_data.note: Veteran eight-time chase winner over this trip but struggling form this year makes him hard to fancy despite experience
runners_data.comment: 13yo who has struggled in three points this year; best watched back over regulation fences
runners_data.spotlight: Eight-time chase winner at up 3m1f but he's well into the veteran stage now and has struggled in three points this year; this looks tough on these terms back over regulation fences and others are preferred.

runners_data.name: Prohus Yank
runners_data.note: Only natural front-runner will get uncontested lead but failed to complete in two previous runs over regulation fences
runners_data.comment: Ties in with Barton Snow on some C&D form in February and he's a key player
runners_data.spotlight: Dual point winner but he was well held in that sphere two weeks ago; failed to complete in two previous runs over regulation fences but he held a narrow lead when he unseated at the last over C&D (soft) in February, and that race was won by subsequent Cheltenham and Aintree hero Barton Snow; looks interesting on that form and he's a key player back in a hunter chase.

runners_data.name: Amenon
runners_data.comment: Sole rules win was almost two years ago and he has lots to find on the figures here
runners_data.spotlight: 1-10 in points and his only win under rules was in a three-runner hunter chase in May 2024; has lots to find on the figures back in this sphere and others are preferred.

runners_data.name: Est Illic
runners_data.note: Modest performer under rules whose recent point win came in a weak field, likely outclassed here
runners_data.comment: Won a point recently but he's a modest performer under rules these days; opposable
runners_data.spotlight: Won a small-field point recently but this veteran is a modest performer under rules these days and was pulled up in two handicaps (including over C&D) in February; opposable back in this sphere.

races.paceDynamic: Prohus Yank is the only natural front-runner in this field and will dictate proceedings without pressure from flag to finish. With all other runners showing prominent/midfield tendencies, he'll get his own way in front over this stamina-sapping 3m trip on good ground. The lack of pace pressure means the gallop will be steady early before building gradually, creating a test of sustained stamina rather than speed. This race shape strongly favours horses with proven staying power who can grind out the finish, rather than those dependent on a strong pace to set up their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prohus Yank leads throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Prohus Yank jumps cleanly and settles into an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: His dual point-winning stamina will prove decisive as he controls the tempo and kicks clear approaching the last fence. The lack of pace pressure plays perfectly into his hands as a natural front-runner.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class horses dominate finish
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a staying test over the final half-mile
scenarios.body: Mr Glass and Potters Party will use their superior ratings and proven hunter chase form to overhaul the leader. Their class advantage becomes telling when the gallop intensifies approaching the business end.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Fix At All times run perfectly
scenarios.trigger: If Fix At All gets the perfect tracking position behind Prohus Yank
scenarios.body: His recent Kempton form suggests he's back to his best and he can use that tactical advantage to strike late. The steady pace will suit his style of racing prominently before finishing strongly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Veteran experience prevails
scenarios.trigger: If The Paddy Pie's eight-time chase-winning experience over this trip proves decisive
scenarios.body: Despite his recent struggles, his proven stamina over 3m+ and course knowledge could see him stay on grimly when others tire. The grinding nature of the contest would suit his dogged style perfectly.

watchPoints.text: Prohus Yank's jumping - he failed to complete in his last two runs over regulation fences and any early mistake would change the race complexion completely
Mr Glass settling early - if he gets too keen tracking Prohus Yank he could empty his stamina reserves before the crucial closing stages
Potters Party's confidence after unseating at Hexham - any hesitancy at the fences could cost him vital ground in a small field
The pace through the middle stages - if Prohus Yank goes too slow it could set up a sprint finish that favours the classier horses behind
Fix At All's position turning for home - he needs to be within striking distance to use his apparent return to form
